verdict.rationale: Skyvern's browser-sessions docs explicitly state that the VNC stream lets you watch or take control at any point, and that human-in-the-loop flows can pause between steps without losing browser state. Session state persists so the agent can pick up where the human left off. Community praise of workflow observability lends light support to the live-watching side. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the takeover/handback mechanics (e.g., how control is resumed by the agent mid-run), independent or hands-on corroboration of live human takeover.
